title: Public Alert No. 033/2026 – Alert on the Voluntary Recall of Sporidex Suspension 125 mg/5 ml (Batch No. DFG4606A)
summary: NAFDAC alerts on a voluntary recall of Sporidex Suspension 125 mg/5 mL (batch DFG4606A) by Ranbaxy Nigeria Ltd. (Sun Pharma) after an impurity exceeding approved limits was found, risking reduced antibiotic effectiveness, treatment failure, resistance and side effects.
